chunks: Among what al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Abī Ḥamzah, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “Do not bring fire near your dead,” meaning smoke or fumigation.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam speaking in this narration
key_terms.الدُّخْنَةَ: smoke or fumigation meant by the mention of fire
key_terms.النَّارَ: fire, prohibited from being brought near the dead here
key_terms.قَالَ: said; indicates the transmitted statement of the Imam

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to bring fire or incense near the deceased in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys an instruction regarding the treatment of the deceased, specifically forbidding bringing fire near them, clarified here as smoke or fumigation. It reflects funeral etiquette and practical rulings connected to the condition and handling of the dead.
